name: av_acc_no_context
source:
{ Accessors in a document with NO DYNAMIC block: the Java's null-context
  defaults, not an error. }

error.message: There are 6 equations and 8 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantities (no defining relation): nparametricruns, tablerun#. Coupled to: d, e. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
